title: 第574章 运尸第573章 血仇
content_zh:
伊妮丝很心急，当天下午，就带着城防卫队和许多不同职业的高精灵来到旅馆门口，看来艾什洗澡的事要往后放一放了。
都不需要仔细想想，艾什就能理解伊妮丝的心态，自己的弟弟本应是做个简单的侦查任务，遇到敌人就撤退，结果遇到伏击一个活人都没能跑回来报信。
身为姐姐，为自己的弟弟抢回暴露在外多天的尸体，谁都会做出这样的决定的，还好当时艾什懒得离开马车去吞食尸体灵魂，当时想着可能还会有伏击，也不想招惹班西女妖。
现在看来，说不定伊妮丝的弟弟，桑迪尔的灵魂还没有前往虚界，当然了，谁又能知道灵魂什么时候去虚界呢？
艾什，卡森和泽瑞尔分别穿上各自的甲胄，带上武器和出行的物品，牵着马从旅馆后院来到街上，巴尼正和伊妮丝说着什么，见到几人出来，两人互相行礼，看来是在商议拿回尸体的细节。
卡森明白艾什不愿和伊妮丝多说话，也不想因为艾什那张臭嘴把这件事搞烂，便和泽瑞尔牵马过去和伊妮丝对话，表明泽瑞尔是神父和牧师的身份，稍稍安抚伊妮丝，省着她因为亲人的失去而做出什么疯狂的事。
艾什则自己骑上马，横过马身去看几人聊天，顺便注意一下伊妮丝带来的人们。
伊妮丝身边站着一匹纯白的鹿，身上还装着鞍具和鳞甲，那鹿头体型以及头上的角很大，大到艾什觉得都有些挡住视野，其余城防卫队士兵身边也都有这种角特别大的鹿。
依稀记得从束灵之书上看过这种鹿，叫做大角鹿，精灵们常常把这种性格温顺，却勇于冲锋的鹿当做骑乘兽，十六名城防卫队士兵牵着大角鹿，后面的城防卫队士兵则没有骑乘兽。
五辆平板马车被驴子......哦，是骡子拉拽，应该是用于收尸的，除了有大角鹿的城防卫队士兵，还有二十四名城防卫队士兵在后面整齐列队，从他们的神态来看，悲愤，也仅有这样的情绪了。
在城防卫队士兵的队伍后面，则是三十多个高精灵，他们之中有穿神职服装的，有平民服装的，也有几个身上背着很大的背包，看起来像是运物人。
“想要在那边直接进行祈祷仪式吗？”
艾什想着，绑紧身上的甲胄绑带和x字型绑带，用力踩踏几脚地面，以稳住甲胄，牵着烤栗子，左手按着黑雀剑的剑柄走向伊妮丝。
三个人的谈话也要到了尾声，伊妮丝正感激地向泽瑞尔行礼，泽瑞尔也还了礼以后，向高精灵神职们走去，还对艾什微笑点头，艾什不明白他这是什么意思，反正泽瑞尔每天都在微笑，自己也没放在心上。
卡森对艾什招手，等艾什走过去后，张开左臂挥向那些城防卫队士兵，不给伊妮丝和艾什说话的机会，也担心艾什那没什么同理心的脑子会使得事情麻烦，先一步开口说：
“城防卫队的士兵们8人一队，每队都有队长，一共5队，算上后面的36个人，我们去桑迪尔奋战过的地方带回他们的尸体，今晚抵达后就在那里举行安息仪式。”
“斥候呢？”
艾什简单对伊妮丝点了下头，垂下眼去挂稳皮革斜挎包，顺便把兜帽斗篷给魂雾灯盖住，卡森犹豫了下，他有些支吾，艾什抬眼看他，又挪向目光到伊妮丝身上。
“你不要和我说，你没有准备斥候。”
被艾什问到的伊妮丝对艾什行抚胸礼，果决的说：“西北边境距离洛瑞安很近，除了桑迪尔......那支边境巡逻队，还有其他的巡逻队。”

“你的意思是说，不需要斥候了？那你以为你.......”
“艾什，我们两个做斥候吧，看你有些发困，你先等我一下，我和伊妮丝小姐商议完细节，我就去找你。”
卡森及时的打断了艾什的话，把艾什剩下的半截话堵在嘴里，艾什皱眉，脸色难看地牵着烤栗子到一边去了，她从皮革斜挎包里拿出束灵之书，不顾高精灵神职中一些能感测到地狱气息的家伙，翻开来查看心往地图。
伊妮丝看起来没理解为什么艾什心情不好，但是稍微和艾什接触下来，她认为艾什就是这样一个总是坏脾气的女人，把心思都放在了和卡森讨论前进的队形，以及对三人的“保护”上了。
一边的艾什啧了声，对伊妮丝的白痴而不满，束灵之书在心往地图空白处给艾什浮现一句话：“高傲的种族，很少才会记住教训。”
“她既然都知道自己弟弟是遭遇了伏击而死，那还不准备斥候？而且不带更多的人，不去找军队帮忙，还带领这些城防卫队士兵？一群守城门的懒鬼能战斗？！”
艾什想不通为什么伊妮丝要这么做决定，她用地狱语和束灵之书猜测路上可能遇到的情况，对精灵的印象又差了几分，尤其是那些神职们把目光投向艾什，低声讨论的时候，艾什更是被他们的窃窃私语激怒。
“你们看什么？地狱气息从你们鼻子吸进去熏伤脑子了？！”
心情极不好的艾什对着那些高精灵神职喊去，高精灵神职们一时停住低语，不过没几秒又开始了交谈，根本不把艾什放在心上，反而更旁若无人的谈论起艾什的身份猜想，对艾什的厌恶根本不掩饰。
和他们的举动把泽瑞尔显得有些尴尬，他试图帮助艾什说几句话，可高精灵神职们傲慢极了，对泽瑞尔的态度也不是很好，也给他弄得心烦，便不再和他们交谈，牵马来到艾什这边。
“和你的新朋友聊完了？”
没好气的艾什连泽瑞尔也嘲笑起来，好在泽瑞尔并不会因为艾什的性格而生气，他耸耸肩，捋着他的马尾辫叹息。
“别开我的玩笑了，艾什，这些高精灵神职不想来的，我刚才和他们聊三神教的安息仪式，他们都不是很想聊下去，看样子，他们觉得为士兵们的灵魂祈祷，是随军牧师的时，而不是来自教会的牧师。”
“这话要是在帝国，这些神职都会被帝国圣女庭吊死，士兵不是为了守护国王，宗教，人民而死？他们不去做祈祷？妈的精灵，我怎么就遇不到一个正常些的精灵。”
“伊拉小姐不是很好吗？”
content_en:
Inis was very anxious. That afternoon, she brought the city defense team and many high elves of different professions to the door of the hotel. It seemed that Ash's bathing would have to be put off for a later time.
Ash didn't need to think carefully to understand Inis's mentality. His brother was supposed to be on a simple reconnaissance mission and retreat when he encountered an enemy. However, he encountered an ambush and not a single living person came back to report the news.
As a sister, anyone would make such a decision to retrieve the corpse that had been exposed for many days for her brother. Fortunately, Ash was too lazy to leave the carriage to devour the soul of the corpse. She was thinking that there might be an ambush and did not want to provoke the Banshee Banshee.
Now it seems that maybe the soul of Inis's brother, Sandil, has not yet gone to the virtual world. Of course, who can know when the soul will go to the virtual world?
Ash, Carson and Zerrell put on their respective armors, took weapons and travel items, and led the horses from the backyard of the hotel to the street. Barney was talking to Inis when they saw a few people coming out. The two of them saluted each other, apparently discussing the details of getting the body back.
Carson understood that Ash didn't want to talk to Inis, and he didn't want to mess up the matter because of Ash's bad mouth, so he and Zerrell led the horse over to talk to Inis, revealing Zerrell's identity as a priest and pastor, so as to comfort Inis a little and prevent her from doing anything crazy because of the loss of her loved ones.
Ash mounted his horse, crossed the horse's body to see a few people chatting, and paid attention to the people brought by Inis.
Next to Inis stood a pure white deer, which was also equipped with a saddle and scales. The deer's head and horns were so big that Ash felt they were blocking his vision. The other city defense soldiers also had deer with such large horns around them.
I vaguely remember reading about this kind of deer from the Book of Spirits, called a big-horned deer. The elves often regard this deer with a docile character but the courage to charge as a riding beast. Sixteen city defense soldiers led the big-horned deer, and the city defense soldiers behind did not have a riding beast.
Five flat-bed carriages were pulled by donkeys... oh, mules. They should be used to collect corpses. In addition to the city defense soldiers with big-antlered deer, there were also twenty-four city defense soldiers lined up behind. Judging from their expressions, this was the only emotion they could feel: grief and indignation.
Behind the team of city defense soldiers, there were more than thirty high elves. Some of them were wearing clerical clothes, some were wearing civilian clothes, and some of them were carrying large backpacks and looked like people transporting things.
“Want to conduct the prayer ceremony directly there?”
Ash thought about it, tightened the armor straps and the X-shaped straps on his body, stepped hard on the ground a few times to stabilize the armor, held Roasted Chestnut in his hand, and walked towards Inis holding the hilt of the Black Sparrow Sword with his left hand.
The conversation between the three people was coming to an end. Inis was gratefully saluting Zerrell. After returning the salute, Zerrell walked towards the high elf priests and smiled and nodded to Ash. Ash didn't understand what he meant. Anyway, Zerrell smiled every day and he didn't take it to heart.
Carson waved to Ash, and after Ash walked over, he opened his left arm and waved at the city defense soldiers. He did not give Inis and Ash a chance to talk. He was also worried that Ash's lack of empathy would cause trouble, so he spoke first:
"The soldiers of the city defense team are in teams of 8, and each team has a captain. There are 5 teams in total, including the 36 people behind. We will go to the place where Sandil fought and bring back their bodies. We will hold a resting ceremony there when we arrive tonight."
"Where's the scout?"
Ash simply nodded to Inis, lowered his eyes to hang up the leather crossbody bag, and covered the hooded cloak with the soul fog lamp. Carson hesitated for a moment, he hesitated a little, Ash raised his eyes to look at him, and then moved his eyes to Inis.
"Don't tell me that you didn't prepare a scout."
Inis was asked by Ash aboutAsh stroked his chest and said decisively: "The northwest border is very close to Lorien. In addition to Sandil...the border patrol team, there are other patrol teams."
"You mean, we don't need scouts anymore? Then you think you..."
"Ash, let's be scouts. I see you're a little sleepy. Please wait for me for a moment. I'll go find you after Miss Inis and I discuss the details."
Carson interrupted Ash's words in time and blocked the remaining half of Ash's words. Ash frowned and took Roasted Chestnut aside with an ugly expression. She took out the Book of Souls from her leather crossbody bag and opened it to check the Heart Map, regardless of some guys in the high elf priesthood who could sense the breath of hell.
Inis didn't seem to understand why Ash was in a bad mood, but after getting in touch with Ash a little bit, she thought that Ash was such a bad-tempered woman, and she focused on discussing the forward formation with Carson and the "protection" of the three of them.
Ash on the side clicked his tongue, dissatisfied with Inis's idiocy. The Book of Souls reflected a sentence to Ash in the blank space of the map in his mind: "A proud race rarely remembers its lessons."
"Since she knew that her brother was ambushed and died, why didn't she prepare to scout? And she didn't bring more people, she didn't go to the army for help, and she still led these city defense soldiers? How can a group of lazy guys guarding the city gate fight?!"
Ash couldn't figure out why Inis made this decision. She used Hell Language and the Book of Soul-binding to guess what might happen on the road, and her impression of the elves was a little worse. Especially when the priests turned their attention to Ash and discussed in low voices, Ash was even more irritated by their whispers.
"What are you looking at? Is the breath of hell inhaled through your noses and injuring your brains?!"
Ash, who was in a very bad mood, shouted to the high elf priests. The high elf priests stopped whispering for a moment, but started talking again within a few seconds. They didn't take Ash to heart at all. Instead, they talked about Ash's identity speculation in a nonchalant manner, and did not hide their disgust for Ash at all.
Zerrell seemed a little embarrassed by their actions. He tried to help Ash by saying a few words, but the high elf priests were extremely arrogant and didn't treat Zerrell very well. This also made him upset, so he stopped talking to them and led his horse to Ash's side.
"Are you done talking to your new friend?"
Ash, who was not angry, even laughed at Zariel. Fortunately, Zariel was not angry because of Ash's character. He shrugged, stroking his ponytail and sighed.
"Don't make fun of me, Ash. These high elf priests don't want to come. I just talked to them about the rest ceremony of the Tritheism. They didn't really want to continue the conversation. It seems that they think praying for the souls of the soldiers is for the military chaplains, not the priests from the church."
"If this were true in the empire, these priests would be hanged by the Holy Maiden Court of the Empire. Didn't the soldiers die to protect the king, religion, and people? They didn't pray? Damn the elves, why can't I meet a normal elf?"
"Isn't Miss Ila very nice?"
